title: 557. Reverse Pairs

examples.explanation: Two index pairs satisfy the greater-than-twice rule.
Three index pairs satisfy the rule.

hints: A modified merge sort can count cross pairs while sorting: both halves are sorted, so one linear scan counts for each left element.
Compare with long (64-bit) values because doubling a 32-bit integer may overflow.
The naive double loop is quadratic; divide and conquer brings it to O(n log n).
